title: Chapter 425: Reappearing On The List
content:
Chapter 425: Reappearing On The List

In the crowd, an inconspicuous boy was now staring at the scene with his bright eyes.

"Senior Hao, the power of rules in this holy land is so strong, do you have the ability to resist?"

Hao Nian asked curiously.

Hearing this question, the boy's bracelet dimmed for a moment, and then a fluorescent flashed, "Bai Xu, do you think of me too awesome? Don't say that I am like this now, even in my heyday, It would be easy for the power of the rules here to suppress me."

He didn't say it very exaggeratedly. Bai Xu's cultivation level has not reached his level yet. Apart from being able to feel the power of the rules here, there is nothing else.

But he is different. Only the real strong man knows clearly that the root of the power of the rules here lies in the person who arranges the arrangement.

At this moment, he was 90% sure that the power of the rules here was definitely arranged by the Lord of the Desolate City, which was said to be the legendary Lord of the Divine Dragon.

Otherwise, why did he not even have the idea of resisting in the face of the power of this rule?

Hearing the words of his senior, Bai Xu smiled awkwardly and didn't ask any more questions.

On the way to Huangcheng, he suddenly thought of his sister. Now that Huangcheng is open, he may have the opportunity to meet his sister.

He didn't want to be able to reunite with his sister, even if he just took a look from a distance, he was satisfied.

But Bai Xu didn't know that Bai Ling had already followed Ao Qing to the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Just as Bai Xu was thinking a lot, a huge list suddenly appeared in one of the largest squares in the outer city.

At this moment, the list emitted dazzling golden light and a sacred aura, which immediately attracted countless creatures to stop.

Several creatures above stared at the list and said, "Fighting Power List? Genius List?"

At the same time, all the foreign creatures entering the deserted city had a sound in their minds, which was the introduction of the two lists.

Anyone who makes the list can receive generous rewards if he can persist on the list for one week.

To be on the combat power list, you only need to have strong strength, no cultivation limits or age limits, as long as you have the strength, you can be on the list.

The Tianjiao List has age restrictions, and only creatures under Long Live can be included in the list.

This sudden list immediately caused quite a stir in the deserted city.

At this time, the list changed again, and lines of text emerged out of thin air.

What is written by line is the reward for every ranking.

All kinds of treasures, magical weapons and weapons appear, and even the fruit of immortality and enlightenment tea appear.

Seeing this, all living beings sucked in cold air, and then they were extremely excited.

A rebellious voice sounded in the crowd, "This combat power list is really tailor-made for me, hahahaha!"

Someone recognized the voice and exclaimed, "It's the Supreme Elder of the Under River Clan!"

Although the Under River Clan is not a top-level strong clan, it is not a third-rate tribe. The Supreme Elder is the strength of the Supreme Lord.

"I want to play the ranking!"

In an instant, the name of the Supreme Elder of the Under River appeared directly at the top of the combat power list.

Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned, and then they understood that the list had just started and there was no one who could stick to the list, so as long as they challenged, they could be on the list.

Thinking of this, most people began to get ready and challenged one after another.

In just a moment, the combat power list was the number of people meeting the standard, with 100 people.

And the Supreme Elder of the Under River is still at the top of the combat power list!

Everyone around them had different expressions, and some people praised the Supreme Elder of the Under River, who was very powerful. However, although the Supreme Elder of the Under River, he had a smile on his face, he felt a little uneasy.

He felt that looking at the entire Chaos Realm, although his strength was not the strongest, he was not very weak, and there should be no problem in the top 30.

Of course, as long as the people in the deserted city don’t take action.

The Supreme Elder of the Dark River stood in front of the combat power list, carefully watching the 100 people on the combat power list. Among these 100 people, almost half of them made up the numbers everywhere, and went up as a conspicuous bag, with actual strength. I'm afraid it's the Supreme Realm of the Heaven.

And at this moment, the name of the 100th suddenly changed, from the original Li Si to the Great Ancestor.

Seeing this name, Elder Dark River's eyelids trembled slightly.

Sure enough, as soon as this name appeared, its ranking suddenly increased, and it was unstoppable all the way. In just a moment, he had already entered the top 30 rankings.

In other words, the opponents facing this Haohan Ancestor almost all defeated the enemy with one move.

"It's actually the ancestor Haohan, who has been famous for a long time. Unexpectedly, even this person in the combat power list attracted him."

"Look, the ancestor Haohan is in the top ten!"

"Damn it, it's just second!"

As soon as everyone finished speaking, the next moment, the figure of the Supreme Elder of the Dark River disappeared from the spot.

At the same time, in a special space.

The Supreme Elder of the Dark River stood here, his expression a little confused. Just now he only felt a warm current flowing from his body, and the next moment he suddenly appeared here.

In the distance, an old man with pale hair and cold face was staring at him.

When he saw the old man, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River glared, "It's you, the Great Ancestor."

"Haha, Anheyu, you are not my opponent, are you surrendering yourself, or will I beat you to death."

Hearing the words of the ancestor Haohan, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River frowned slightly, and he seemed to have no grudges with the other party, and he actually wanted to kill himself for a ranking.

As for it?

At this time, a light curtain appeared in front of him, whether he surrendered.

Seeing this, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River was slightly stunned, and was silent for a moment, but he still chose not.

Then, he looked at the vast ancestor in the distance and bowed, saying, "Please give me advice."

He knew that he was probably not the opponent's opponent, so he tried to be polite, and perhaps the other party would show mercy and make himself more decent to lose.

But the ancestor Haohan smiled.

The next moment, the law of imprisonment dissipated, and the ancestor Haohan killed directly towards the Supreme Elder of the Under River and attacked Unparalleled!

"you!"

Feeling the Great Ancestor who had fully fired as soon as he came up, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River was a little confused, but he still hurriedly took action to resist, but the strength of the two was obviously not on the same level.

In just a few moves, the Supreme Elder of the Under River was suppressed and then he was beaten to vomit blood.

"Wait, wait a moment, I surrender, I surrender!!"

He really couldn't beat it, and the Supreme Elder of the Under River had to surrender. At the same time, he was extremely depressed. Did the Ancestor Haohan had any misunderstanding with him? He almost wanted to kill him.

However, as time passed, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River suddenly felt something was wrong.

His surrender had no effect, and the ancestor Haohan was still ruthless. At this time, the ancestor Haohan said, "Dark River, stop shouting, there is only a chance to surrender at the beginning. Once the battle begins, it will not be allowed. Surrendered."

"The next ending is only a dead end."

This is the result of what Haohan Ancestor learned from a hundred people who have been playing all the way.
